sections.heading: Variation of Parameters & Greens Kernel Practice Exercises

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''-y=2 \) using variation of parameters.
Find a particular solution of \( y''-4y'+4y=6 \) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=e^{2x} \), \( y_2=xe^{2x} \) (repeated root), \( W=e^{4x} \). \( u_1'=-\dfrac{y_2(6)}{W}=-6xe^{-2x} \), \( u_2'=\dfrac{y_1(6)}{W}=6e^{-2x} \); integrating and substituting back gives \( y_p=\tfrac32 \) (constant) — matching what undetermined coefficients would give directly, \( A=6/4 \).

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''+4y=8 \) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=\cos2x \), \( y_2=\sin2x \), \( W=2 \). \( u_1'=-\dfrac{y_2(8)}{W}=-4\sin2x\Rightarrow u_1=2\cos2x \); \( u_2'=\dfrac{y_1(8)}{W}=4\cos2x\Rightarrow u_2=2\sin2x \). So \( y_p=u_1y_1+u_2y_2=2\cos^22x+2\sin^22x=2 \).

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''+y=\cot x \) (for \( 0<x<\pi \)) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=\cos x \), \( y_2=\sin x \), \( W=1 \). \( u_1'=-\sin x\cot x=-\cos x\Rightarrow u_1=-\sin x \); \( u_2'=\cos x\cot x=\csc x-\sin x\Rightarrow u_2=\cos x-\ln|\csc x+\cot x| \). So \( y_p=u_1y_1+u_2y_2=-\sin x\cos x+\big(\cos x-\ln|\csc x+\cot x|\big)\sin x=-\sin x\ln|\csc x+\cot x| \) (the \( \sin x\cos x \) terms cancel).

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''-4y=e^{2x} \) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=e^{2x} \), \( y_2=e^{-2x} \), \( W=-4 \). Here \( r=2 \) matches a root — no modification is needed for variation of parameters, unlike undetermined coefficients. \( u_1'=\dfrac14\Rightarrow u_1=\dfrac{x}{4} \); \( u_2'=-\dfrac{e^{4x}}{4}\Rightarrow u_2=-\dfrac{e^{4x}}{16} \). So \( y_p=u_1y_1+u_2y_2=\Big(\dfrac{x}{4}-\dfrac{1}{16}\Big)e^{2x} \).

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''+4y=\csc2x \) (for \( 0<x<\pi/2 \)) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=\cos2x \), \( y_2=\sin2x \), \( W=2 \). \( u_1'=-\dfrac12\Rightarrow u_1=-\dfrac{x}{2} \); \( u_2'=\dfrac12\cot2x\Rightarrow u_2=\dfrac14\ln|\sin2x| \). So \( y_p=u_1y_1+u_2y_2=-\dfrac{x}{2}\cos2x+\dfrac14\sin2x\ln|\sin2x| \).

questions.q: Find a particular solution of \( y''-6y'+9y=\dfrac{e^{3x}}{x^2} \) (for \( x>0 \)) using variation of parameters.
questions.answer: \( y_1=e^{3x} \), \( y_2=xe^{3x} \) (repeated root), \( W=e^{6x} \). \( u_1'=-\dfrac1x\Rightarrow u_1=-\ln x \); \( u_2'=\dfrac{1}{x^2}\Rightarrow u_2=-\dfrac1x \). So \( y_p=u_1y_1+u_2y_2=-e^{3x}\ln x-e^{3x}=-e^{3x}(\ln x+1) \).
